source: Owner direct chat after playing MSQ-119
owner_message_original: Поиграл в версию. Что нужно сделать сейчас - научить врага стрелять в движении, он должен быть более динамичным. На счет выглядывания из-за угла, нужно именно выглядывание с наклоном корпуса, котороые обычно делается на Q и E в шутерах. Сможешь такое сделать?
owner_message_english_translation: I played the version. What needs doing now is teaching the enemy to shoot while moving; he should be more dynamic. As for peeking around corners, I mean peeking with a torso lean, like Q and E in shooters. Can you do that?
decision: Implement mobile enemy fire and actual left/right torso-lean cover peeking on delivered MSQ-119. The Q/E reference describes enemy posture, not new player controls.
controller_slicing: CAI-T03 under MSQ-101, consuming existing senses, navigation, cover and GASP/Mover rifle presentation. Supersedes the prior stationary-only fire restriction for supported tactical movement and step-out-only lateral peek interpretation.
execution: One Multica production executor and one primary independent technical reviewer at verified Astra/max/default, fast disabled. Controller handles administration, acceptance and local task closure commit.
verification: Retain owner-only gameplay testing: native build, focused production-policy/pose wiring checks and independent source review. Read-only editor/asset inspection and guarded native reload are allowed. No agent PIE, firing, gameplay simulation, gameplay screenshots or performance probes.
preservation: Preserve owner config/project/map edits, accepted asset sources and historical evidence, physical recovery authority, finite projectiles and current slowdown. Archive exact pre-edit asset bytes and register any changed asset revisions without altering historical fingerprints.
later_scope: Player lean controls, additional weapons, live group tactics, health/death, map/art redesign and undispatched successors remain separate.
